# MAHA FIREFIGHTERS

> Industrial Fire Hydrant and Automatic Sprinklers System Contractors in Delhi NCR. NBC 2016 Part 4 & IS Code Compliant.

Maha Firefighters (Maha Enterprises) is a premier fire protection engineering and contracting company based in Delhi NCR, India. With over 15 years of field experience and 250+ satisfied industrial and commercial clients, we specialize in turnkey design, installation, testing, commissioning, and AMC maintenance of industrial fire suppression and detection systems.

## Primary Fire Protection Services
- [Fire Hydrant Systems](https://mahafirefighters.com/firehydrantsystems): Complete turnkey high-pressure water suppression networks, fire pumps, jockey pumps, landing valves, and hose cabinets aligned with IS 3844.
- [Automatic Fire Sprinkler Systems](https://mahafirefighters.com/firesprinklersystems): 24/7 unattended automatic suppression networks, rapid-response sprinkler heads, zone control valves, and hydraulic pipe installations aligned with IS 15105.
- [Fire Alarm & Detection Systems](https://mahafirefighters.com/firealarmsystems): Addressable and conventional intelligent alarm panels, smoke/heat/multi-sensor detectors, manual call points, and hooters compliant with IS 2189.
- [Fire Extinguisher Refilling & Sales](https://mahafirefighters.com/fire-extinguisher-refilling-service): Dedicated in-house refilling plant, 35 Bar hydrostatic pressure testing (HPT), free doorstep pickup & delivery across Delhi NCR, and genuine chemical refills for ABC, CO2, Foam, Clean Agent, and Water CO2 cylinders (IS 2190).
- [Fire Safety Drills & Training](https://mahafirefighters.com/firesafetydrill): Certified on-site fire evacuation drills, live fire extinguisher simulation, emergency response protocol training, and staff familiarization compliant with NBC Part 4.
- [All Services Overview](https://mahafirefighters.com/services): Comprehensive directory of all fire engineering solutions and turnkey contracting services.

## Technical Knowledge & Compliance Guides
- [NBC Fire Safety Guidelines for Industrial Buildings](https://mahafirefighters.com/blog/nbc-fire-safety-guidelines-industrial-delhi-ncr): Mandatory NBC 2016 Part 4 compliance, occupant load calculations, and fire clearance requirements.
- [Industrial Fire Hydrant Maintenance Checklist](https://mahafirefighters.com/blog/industrial-fire-hydrant-maintenance-checklist-testing-intervals): Statutory testing intervals, jockey pump cut-in pressure calibrations, and preventive maintenance guides.
- [Automatic Sprinklers vs Fire Hydrants](https://mahafirefighters.com/blog/automatic-fire-sprinklers-vs-hydrants-dual-layer-protection): Dual-layer protection engineering for high-risk industrial facilities.
- [Fire Protection Knowledge Base](https://mahafirefighters.com/blog): Complete library of engineering articles and standards guides.
